% Based on the TikZ manual custom coordinate-system interface.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}

\tikzdeclarecoordinatesystem{timeline}{%
  \pgfmathsetmacro\timelinex{(#1-1975)/3}
  \pgfpointxy{\timelinex}{0}%
}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[x=6mm,y=6mm]
  \draw[->,thick] (timeline cs:1975) -- (timeline cs:2020);
  \foreach \year in {1975,1980,...,2020} {
    \draw (timeline cs:\year) -- ++(0,0.3) node[above,font=\tiny]{\year};
  }
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
